Community Scam Propagation Intelligence

Outbreak Radar

Real-time detection of coordinated scam patterns spreading across geographic, social, and behavioral clusters. Time-based diffusion modeling with coarse spatial units protects customer privacy while preventing fraud contagion.

Non-Discriminatory Spatial Context: Location data is strictly coarse (division & coarse synthetic cells) and contextual. Upay Shield never infers individual guilt or increases risk based on geographic origin alone.
